description: This source file defines the 'ConceptSource' class for the OpenMRS project, representing sources of medical concept dictionaries such as ICD9, ICD10, SNOMED, etc. It includes fields for identifiers and codes, along with getter/setter methods.

classes.name: ConceptSource
classes.description: Represents a source of medical concepts in the OpenMRS system, with identifiers and related metadata.

methods.name: getConceptSourceId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the ConceptSource.

methods.name: setConceptSourceId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the ConceptSource.

methods.name: getHl7Code
methods.description: Returns the HL7 code associated with this ConceptSource.

methods.name: setHl7Code
methods.description: Sets the HL7 code for this ConceptSource.

methods.name: getUniqueId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier string for this ConceptSource.

methods.name: setUniqueId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier string for this ConceptSource.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Overrides the method to get the ID, returning conceptSourceId.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Overrides the method to set the ID, setting conceptSourceId.
